name: BC & EBC Girls Residential +2 High School
benefit:
- Free enrolment
- Free accommodation
- Free food and sacks (as per menu)
- The amount for clothes, books, medicine, cleaning etc. is paid to the girl students through DBT
- Laboratory with modern facilities
- Vocational training, skill development, horticulture etc
- Facility of quality study and guidance through Jananayak Library and Digital Study Centre.
- Free competitive, and high quality boo
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a girl student.
1. The applicant should be a resident of Bihar.
1. The applicant should belong to the Backward Class (BC) or Extremely Backward Class (EBC).
1. The benefits under this scheme are available to girl students from Class 6 to Class 12.
1. Selection of girl students for Classes VI, VII, VIII, and IX will be based on an entrance examination.
1. The annual income of the applicant's parents/guardians should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-.
1. The applicant’s age limit for enrolment:

- 11-13 years for Class 6th- 12-14 years for Class 7th- 13-15 years for Class 8th- 14-16 years for Class 9th
